verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26314959 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318663 (dated 2026-05-19). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 8,500 units at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-06-25. Terms are EXW Boise, payment NET30. No handwriting or corrections.
red_flags: The delivery terms contradict each other. They say EXW Boise and that DDP is not agreed. They also say freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays freight, so the added charges need clarifying.
The document shows no total price and no document date. Only the PO date (2026-05-19) and the confirmed delivery date (2026-06-25) are given.
observations: Clean printed PDF with no stamps, signatures, handwriting or damage.
The description wraps over three lines in the table (Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5).
Quantity uses an English thousands separator (8,500 = 8500).
